canon_ref.note: The Healer says only a high-level Healer or a rare Gnoll [Bone Surgeon] might help. She went alone so the others would not see. She still dreams of Skinner.

b3.yvlon_learns_the_metal_is_in_her_bone.summary: An Ocre [Healer] tells Yvlon the melted metal has bonded to her bones and cannot come out; a [Blacksmith] offers to trim the outside with an enchanted blade. Alone, Yvlon lets herself weep once. Then a boy bursts in: a noble's coach has come to take Ryoka.

b3.ressa_takes_ryoka_from_ocre.news: Ryoka Griffin left Ocre at dusk in Magnolia Reinhart's coach, its trunk stuffed with every delivery for Invrisil the Runners' Guild had.

canon_ref.note: Dusk, day 76 (guess). Yvlon calls Magnolia 'Aunt'; the Byres are a Reinhart branch house. The Horns' relics, sealed bag, pack and several hundred gold go with Ryoka. Her Celum schedule ends here.

b3.ressa_takes_ryoka_from_ocre.summary: The drunk crowd draws steel on Ressa, and the Horns stand by Ryoka; Ressa promises nothing. Ryoka gives in for fifteen minutes' grace: she takes the Horns' relics and gold in her bag of holding, bullies Ocre's Runners' Guild for every Invrisil delivery, and rides off, flipping off the crowd.

canon_ref.note: Ressa threatens to hit her if she keeps needling, so Ryoka climbs up front beside Reynold. Ivolethe says this is the first step. Not a class or Skill.

b3.ryoka_glimpses_the_wind_from_the_coac.summary: Rather than sit with Ressa, Ryoka rides up front beside Reynold, faster than any car she has known. Ivolethe flies alongside, riding the currents, and for a moment Ryoka sees the wind itself, a clear ripple in the air, before it is gone.

b3.magnolias_coach_runs_through_rags_tri.news: A Goblin tribe thousands strong, with young and wolf riders, is marching north through the snow between Ocre and Invrisil. A noble's coach barely got through it.
b3.magnolias_coach_runs_through_rags_tri.rumor: Travellers tell of a second Goblin horde in the north, fleeing its own kind: Hobs, Carn Wolf riders and whole families on the march.

canon_ref.note: Ivolethe says the Goblin Lord's great army waits below the pass, and this smaller tribe flees it. Ryoka names Rags. The Hob with a crimson sword is unnamed and not linked to garen.

b3.magnolias_coach_runs_through_rags_tri.summary: Too late, Ivolethe warns of Goblins ahead. The coach tops a hill into a column of thousands, with young, Hobs and Carn Wolf riders. Ressa hides it with the coach's [Invisibility Field] until Rags' black crossbow bolt breaks the spell; Ressa's throwing stars hold off a Hob with a crimson sword.
